project.name: MCP Search :: Schema
project.description:
Whole-schema search orchestration: given a query, select the relevant tables (hybrid embedding-shortlist then optional LLM refine), expand along foreign-key relationships, run hybrid search against each selected table via search-core's SearchAdapter, and fuse the results across tables with RRF.
The graph/traversal/selection/fusion logic here is pure and depends only on search-core + the JDK. The I/O edges (live information_schema reads, real embedding and LLM calls) are behind SPI interfaces in this module; concrete JDBC/LLM implementations that need a real environment are marked as such.
